cards.card_text: And they top it off: "Whereas my father scourged you with whips, I will scourge you with scorpions." I think those words would land hard on people already under a heavy yoke.
cards.verse_text: Whereas my father scourged you with whips, I will scourge you with scorpions.’”
cards.snippet: Whereas my father scourged you with whips, I will scourge you with scorpions.’”

cards.card_text: The king answers them harshly, rejecting the elders' advice and speaking as the young men advised: “Whereas my father scourged you with whips, I will scourge you with scorpions.” Whips to SCORPIONS.
cards.verse_text: Whereas my father scourged you with whips, I will scourge you with scorpions.”
cards.snippet: Whereas my father scourged you with whips, I will scourge you with scorpions.”

cards.card_text: He's not to be afraid, though briers and thorns surround him and he dwells among scorpions.
cards.verse_text: Do not be afraid, though briers and thorns surround you, and you dwell among scorpions.
cards.snippet: …be afraid, though briers and thorns surround you, and you dwell among scorpions.

cards.card_text: Jesus tells them He has given them authority to tread on snakes and scorpions, and nothing will harm them.
cards.verse_text: Behold, I have given you authority to tread on snakes and scorpions, and over all the power of the enemy.
cards.snippet: Behold, I have given you authority to tread on snakes and scorpions, and over all the power of the enemy.

cards.card_text: Or if the son asks for an egg, who gives him a scorpion?
cards.verse_text: Or if he asks for an egg, will give him a scorpion?
cards.snippet: Or if he asks for an egg, will give him a scorpion?

cards.card_text: Then out of the smoke, locusts descend on the earth, and they're given power like that of the scorpions of the earth.
cards.verse_text: And out of the smoke, locusts descended on the earth, and they were given power like that of the scorpions of the earth.
cards.snippet: …on the earth, and they were given power like that of the scorpions of the earth.

cards.card_text: They can only torment those people for five months, and the torment is like the stinging of a scorpion.
cards.verse_text: The locusts were not given power to kill them, but only to torment them for five months, and their torment was like the stinging of a scorpion.
cards.snippet: …for five months, and their torment was like the stinging of a scorpion.

cards.card_text: To top it off, they have tails with stingers like scorpions, with power to injure people for five months.
cards.verse_text: They had tails with stingers like scorpions, which had the power to injure people for five months.
cards.snippet: They had tails with stingers like scorpions, which had the power to injure people for five months.
